correctness.rationale: Independent exhaustive projective enumeration uses 993 normalized points/dually lines and computes exactly 32 points satisfying X^3Y+Y^3Z+Z^3X=0 modulo 31. Complete incidence scan gives line spectrum 354,334,256,18,31 for 0..4 rational contacts. Independent recursive enumeration of every increasing-index family of pairwise curve-disjoint 4-secants returns depth counts 1,31,270,804,805,207,3,0, forbidding 7 and hence 8; eight covering lines would require eight disjoint 4-secants by Bezout and 32 points. Explicit nine witness lines cover all 32; tau=9. Full finite exhaustive proof; no extrapolation.
